note: These are research evidence findings only. Public source text can support a general principle without approving any item or COLORA SKU. No internal commercial certificate was accessed or published.

returns.scope: Public web policy observed, owner approval/current live applicability still must be checked

warranty.scope: Public web policy observed, service scope and exceptions remain conditional

privacy.scope: Public marketing permission wording, not independent legal compliance advice

shipping.scope: Published preparation and delivery estimates, not per-order promise

gia.scope: GIA report services and detectable treatments, not evidence for a COLORA stone

giagrade.scope: GIA does not assign universal grading to colored stones

rjc.scope: Scope of precious-metal supply-chain standard, not COLORA certification

rjcgloss.scope: COC transfer document does not imply product conformity certification

groups.finding: 2,3–8 triệu VND is written as planning range in existing question bank; not corroborated by dated founder-signed price decision or live SKU price list. Avoid equating a proposal with current prices.
needed: Founder decision ID with approval/effective date
SKU price export snapshot and scope

groups.finding: Existing bank asserts GENIA276 Ag 930‰ substrate and proprietary finishing; technical supplier documents, finished-SKU coverage and meaning/ownership of proprietary finish not independently verified.
needed: Supplier assay/alloy specification and lot linkage
Finish layers and approved technical claim scope per SKU
Owner signoff and effective claim version

groups.finding: RJC COC addresses traceability of precious metals; certification/transfer documents do not automatically mean all finished COLORA products are product-certified.
needed: Supplier's valid CoC certificate and scope
Transfer documentation for specific material lots
Matching evidence to each applicable SKU

groups.finding: Nickel-free process/supply declarations and a universal hypoallergenic claim are different; the first needs scope proof, the second must not be promised.
needed: Nickel-free bill of materials, finish scope and production attestations
Applicable product compliance/test documentation

groups.finding: Natural, laboratory-grown, detectable treatment and geographic origin are separate identification/report fields. No conclusion about treatment for a COLORA stone follows from a natural designation alone.
needed: Stone-level identification and treatment disclosure evidence
Exact report type/number only in access-controlled source
SKU/stone provenance linkage

groups.finding: QC checklist concepts (cut, depth, chip, color, fit) may structure training but there is no authenticated COLORA-specific acceptance tolerance or signed technical SOP in public repo.
needed: Versioned Gem QC SOP with role approvals
SKU-specific L×W×D, girdle and setting tolerances
Approved defect gates and escalation conditions

groups.finding: 48h is notification for specified receipt problems; 14d return window follows eligible request acceptance. No blanket change-of-mind return entitlement is stated.
needed: Policy owner confirms published page version is current
Clarify legal consumer rights and applicable exceptions

groups.finding: Basic cleaning is described as free; specialized polishing, replating, repairs or stone replacement are subject to evaluation and quote.
needed: Current care services availability and scope
Owner confirms costs and exception handling

groups.finding: Ordering or account creation does not by itself grant marketing consent; customer can opt out under published policy.
needed: Marketing/privacy owner confirms actual platform consent capture and unsubscribe
Applicable laws and retention review

groups.finding: A visibly loose mounted gem merits stop-wearing and contact for inspection; training advice is prudent but technical escalation SOP and channel must be signed off.
needed: Approved Client Care triage and safe-storage script
Authorized workshop inspection route and escalation
